quotes.text: Why not use those providers directly? Does Cloudflare need to be in the middle of everything?
quotes.author: binarymax
quotes.extraction_note: Textbook grug anti-middleman instinct, stated in two blunt sentences. Kept as a rhetorical question because the question IS the joke — kept verbatim to preserve voice.

quotes.text: Create bot detection and bot protection, then sell crawlers. Is this the peak of hypocrisy?
quotes.author: sreekanth850
quotes.extraction_note: Sharp, funny callout of the business model contradiction: fence out the bots, then monetize the fence. Controversial, memorable, needs no context.
